Job Location: Ikeja - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

	Promote and sell the company's telecom products and services to prospective customers.

	Educate customers on product features, pricing, and promotional offers.
	Process customer applications and ensure all required documentation is completed accurately.

	Minimum of 2 years of proven sales experience in the telecommunications or insurance industry is mandatory.
	Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong customer relationship management and prospecting skills.

Head of Brokerage Job at GIG Logistics




        
    

        
        GIG Logistics is a member of The GIG Group and prides itself as Nigeria’s leading logistics company. Incorporated in 2012 and headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, GIG Logistics leverages on technology to gain competitive advantage. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head of Brokerage

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary 
     

            
    




	The Head of Brokerage will provide strategic leadership for the Company's customs brokerage operations, ensuring efficient import and export clearance, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
	The role is responsible for managing brokerage teams, building strong relationships with regulatory authorities, optimizing clearance processes, and driving business growth. 


Key Responsibilities 


	Lead and oversee all customs brokerage operations, ensuring timely and compliant clearance of import and export shipments. 
	Develop and implement brokerage strategies to improve operational efficiency, service delivery, and profitability. 
	Ensure compliance with Nigeria Customs Service regulations and other applicable trade, port, and government agency requirements. 
	Build and maintain strong working relationships with regulatory agencies, shipping lines, terminal operators, freight partners, and other key stakeholders. 
	Oversee customs documentation, tariff classification, valuation, duty assessment, and regulatory compliance. 
	Monitor operational KPIs, cargo clearance timelines, and customer service performance, implementing improvements where necessary. 
	Identify and mitigate compliance, operational, and commercial risks associated with brokerage activities. 
	Collaborate with Sales, Freight Forwarding, Operations, Finance, and Customer Experience teams to deliver seamless logistics solutions. 
	Lead, mentor, and develop the Brokerage team to drive high performance and continuous improvement. 
	Prepare management reports, operational analyses, and strategic recommendations to support business growth. 


Requirements 


	Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Law, Economics, or a related discipline. 
	Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in Customs Brokerage, Freight Forwarding, Shipping, International Trade, or Logistics, with at least 4 years in a leadership role. 
	Strong knowledge of customs regulations, import/export procedures, tariff classification, valuation, and trade compliance. 
	Proven experience managing customs clearance operations and engaging with regulatory authorities. 
	Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills. 
	Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on operational excellence. 
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and customs brokerage, freight forwarding, or ERP systems. 
	Professional certifications in Customs Administration, Freight Forwarding, Supply Chain Management, or International Trade will be an added advantage. 


Preferred Experience:


	Candidates with experience in logistics, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, shipping, maritime, aviation cargo, or international trade will be highly preferred. 


Key Competencies:


	Customs Brokerage Operations 
	Trade Compliance & Regulatory Affairs 
	Import & Export Management 
	Freight Forwarding 
	Customs Documentation & Tariff Classification 
	Leadership & Team Management 
	Strategic Planning 
	Stakeholder & Government Relations 


Operational Excellence:


	Risk Management 
	Customer Relationship Management 
	Commercial & Business Acumen.
